Title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Link wakes up after a hundred years of sleep in a ruined Hyrule and sets out to defeat Calamity Ganon in a huge open world full of freedom.

Title: Assassin's Creed Mirage
description: A return to the series' roots: follow Basim, a street thief in ninth-century Baghdad, as he joins the Hidden Ones and learns the art of stealth.

Title: Cuphead
description: A run-and-gun platformer with hand-drawn 1930s cartoon visuals, where two brothers must pay their debt to the Devil by defeating brutal bosses.

Title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: An open-world action RPG set in Night City, where you play V, a mercenary searching for a unique implant that holds the key to immortality.

Title: GTA VI
description: The next entry in Rockstar's open-world crime saga, set in the state of Leonida and its Vice City, with a new pair of protagonists.

Title: Elden Ring
description: An action RPG created by FromSoftware and George R. R. Martin: explore the Lands Between, face demanding bosses and become the Elden Lord.

Title: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: The story of Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang as they try to survive in the dying American Wild West of 1899.
